@m0saic-dev/devops/run-recap/v1.label: Run Recap
@m0saic-dev/devops/run-recap/v1.description: The report an agent-workflow run sends when it is done: status, trigger, each step with its kind, duration and retries, the outcome, up to four stat tiles, the cost and the link. One more job on run.completed turns the run record into props; the agent writes one sentence, the template keeps every report looking like one.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Where the report is going; sets the canvas it renders at when the resolution is left locked to the template. chat is 16:9 at 1920x1080 for a Slack, Discord or Teams player; email is the same frame at 1280x720, a lighter file for an inbox; square is 1080x1080 for a chat thumbnail or a dashboard tile; mobile is 9:16 (1080x1920) and lists the steps. An explicit width and height still win.

brandName.label: Brand
brandName.description: The small wordmark on every frame, and the clip's name. A logo replaces the wordmark on the canvas. Required.

brandLogo.label: Brand logo
brandLogo.description: Zero or one logo in place of the wordmark text: an image or a short video, which loops muted. An absolute path from the CLI, or a picked file in Make.

kicker.label: Kicker
kicker.description: The small label opposite the wordmark. Empty removes it.

workflowName.label: Workflow
workflowName.description: The workflow that ran, large, beside the status. Required.

status.label: Status
status.description: How the run ended: succeeded, failed, needs_review or cancelled. Sets the badge and its colour.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger
triggerLabel.description: What started the run, in one line: the ticket, the alert, the schedule. Empty removes it.
triggerLabel.placeholder: Ticket ACME-482 - Fix null pointer in checkout

startedLabel.label: Started
startedLabel.description: When the run started, as text. Empty removes it.

durationLabel.label: Duration
durationLabel.description: How long the run took, as text, after the start time. Empty removes it.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: The steps in order, 1 to 12, each { name, kind: agent | run | tool, status: passed | failed | skipped | running, durationSec, retries }. Six cards show; more collapse into '+N more'.

outcomeTitle.label: Outcome
outcomeTitle.description: The result in one line. Required.

summary.label: Summary
summary.description: The agent's one or two sentences on what it did, wrapped to three lines. Empty removes it.
summary.placeholder: Null-checked the cart total and added a regression test.

stats.label: Stats
stats.description: Up to four tiles, each { label, value } - files changed, lines, tests, cost. Values are text, so '+120 -34' works.

costLabel.label: Cost line
costLabel.description: What the run cost and where it ran, as text, on the last row. Empty removes it.

outcomeUrl.label: Link
outcomeUrl.description: Where to go, in the pill on the last row. Empty removes the pill.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Dark (a near-black page, light text) or light (a cool paper page, dark text). Background and Text override either half when set.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The brand colour: the link pill, agent-step lines and the progress line, as #rrggbb. Statuses keep their own green / red / amber / grey.

background.label: Background
background.description: The page colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

ink.label: Text
ink.description: The text colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's. Secondary lines and cards are this colour mixed toward the page.

durationSec.label: Length (s)
durationSec.description: Clip length in whole seconds, 8 to 30. The steps land through the first half, the outcome holds the second; an explicit duration pin overrides it.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: check the layout contract (every line fits its box, the dots stay round, the progress line holds the bottom edge) and draw it over the frame.

@m0saic-dev/devtools/visual-diff/v1.label: Visual Diff
@m0saic-dev/devtools/visual-diff/v1.description: main vs this PR: two captures of the same page (any HTML, taken in a real browser by tools/capture-html.mjs) drawn as labelled wireframes side by side, every difference found by matching element to element, outlined and numbered, and visited by a camera with a card per change. Writes each side's layout as an .m0c sidecar with every area labelled, and the diff as JSON - the exact geometry of what changed, not just a picture of it.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Where the clip is going; sets the canvas it renders at when the resolution is left locked to the template. pr is 16:9 at 1920x1080 for a PR comment or a review call; chat is 1280x720; square and mobile stack the two windows. An explicit width and height still win.

brandName.label: Brand
brandName.description: The small wordmark on every frame, and the clip's name. A logo replaces the wordmark on the canvas. Required.

brandLogo.label: Brand logo
brandLogo.description: Zero or one logo in place of the wordmark text: an image or a short video, which loops muted.

title.label: Title
title.description: The change, in one line - the PR number and its title. Required.

before.label: Baseline capture
before.description: The page on main, as tools/capture-html.mjs writes it (page-skeleton capture schema with a label and path per area). Paste the JSON, or double-click the left window.

after.label: PR capture
after.description: The same page on the PR branch. Differences are found by matching paths, so capture both with the same tool and viewport.

baseLabel.label: Baseline name
baseLabel.description: The name on the left window.

headLabel.label: Change name
headLabel.description: The name on the right window.

statusLabel.label: Status
statusLabel.description: One line under the title, right-aligned: the test run, the page count. Empty removes it.

notes.label: Reviewer notes
notes.description: One line per visited change, in reading order (up to 140 characters each): shown on the card while the camera is on it. A change without a note shows what changed instead.

maxStops.label: Changes to visit
maxStops.description: How many primary changes the camera visits, 1 to 6, in reading order. Every change stays outlined and numbered.

tolerancePx.label: Tolerance (px)
tolerancePx.description: A move or resize smaller than this many pixels is not a difference, 0 to 32.

showLabels.label: Area labels
showLabels.description: Draw each area's name and size inside its outline - the debug-layout view of the real page.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Light (a cool paper page, dark text) or dark (a near-black page, light text). Background and Text override either half when set.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The colour of change: primary outlines, badges, the caption, the progress line, as #rrggbb. Removals stay red.

background.label: Background
background.description: The page colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

ink.label: Text
ink.description: The text colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

durationSec.label: Length (s)
durationSec.description: How long the board holds before the camera moves, in whole seconds, 6 to 30. Every visited change adds a stop, so the clip grows with the changes; an explicit duration pin squeezes or holds the whole thing.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: check the layout contract and draw it over the frame.

@m0saic-dev/insights/weekly-brief/v1.label: Weekly Brief
@m0saic-dev/insights/weekly-brief/v1.description: The Monday brief as a video: a greeting, one sentence on the week, up to six stat tiles with a signed delta and a sparkline each, the two or three things worth knowing, and where the numbers came from. A brief is a list of questions answered - a data-retrieval layer returns the rows and the caption, the template is where they land, and the exec gets the same video every week with only the numbers moving.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Where the brief is going; sets the canvas it renders at when the resolution is left locked to the template. email is 16:9 at 1920x1080 for an inbox player or a slide; chat is the same frame at 1280x720, a lighter file; square is 1080x1080 with two tiles across; mobile is 9:16 (1080x1920), two tiles across and the rest stacked. An explicit width and height still win.

brandName.label: Brand
brandName.description: The small wordmark on every frame, and the clip's name. A logo replaces the wordmark on the canvas. Required.

brandLogo.label: Brand logo
brandLogo.description: Zero or one logo in place of the wordmark text: an image or a short video, which loops muted. An absolute path from the CLI, or a picked file in Make.

title.label: Title
title.description: What this is, in the top-right line. Empty removes it.

periodLabel.label: Period
periodLabel.description: Which week, after the title in the top-right line. Empty removes it.

greeting.label: Greeting
greeting.description: The words before the name on the first frame. Empty leaves the name alone.

recipientName.label: Recipient
recipientName.description: Who the brief is for, in the greeting. Empty removes the greeting line.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The one sentence on the week, under the greeting - the agent's summary. Required.
headline.placeholder: Revenue is up 8% on last week, carried by returning customers.

metrics.label: Metrics
metrics.description: One to six tiles, each { label, series: [numbers, oldest first, up to 24], format: number | currency | percent, upIsGood, chart: line | bars, caption, note }. The series is the source of truth: its last point is the value, its last change the delta, the run the chart (the shipped line chart or bar graph, nested). A note (up to 140 characters) makes the tile a stop: the video zooms in on it, shows the note on a card, and moves on - click a tile's card in Make to add one. A one-off number with no series takes value and delta as text instead.

deltaLabel.label: Delta label
deltaLabel.description: The period every delta compares to, after each delta. Empty removes it.

highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.description: Up to three lines worth knowing, under the tiles, each with a dot.

footer.label: Footer
footer.description: Provenance on the last row: how many questions, answered from which sources, when. Empty removes it.
footer.placeholder: 6 questions, answered live from orders_db and support_db

ctaUrl.label: Link
ctaUrl.description: Where to go, in the pill on the last row. Empty removes the pill.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Light (a cool paper page, dark text) or dark (a near-black page, light text). Background and Text override either half when set.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The brand colour: the current period of every chart, the highlight dots, the link pill and the progress line, as #rrggbb. Deltas keep their own green / red.

background.label: Background
background.description: The page colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

ink.label: Text
ink.description: The text colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's. Secondary lines and tiles are this colour mixed toward the page.

durationSec.label: Length (s)
durationSec.description: How long the board takes to build and hold, in whole seconds, 8 to 30. Every tile with a note adds a stop after that (zoom in, time to read, move on), so the clip grows with the notes; an explicit duration pin squeezes or holds the whole thing.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: check the layout contract (every line fits its box, the dots stay round, the progress line holds the bottom edge) and draw it over the frame.

@m0saic-dev/integrations/chipset/v1.label: Chipset
@m0saic-dev/integrations/chipset/v1.description: Your product as the chip on a circuit board, wired to every partner: a glowing packet runs down each trace in turn and lights the partner's pill. Edit the partner list and the pills re-flow and the traces re-route, one or two rows on a wide canvas, two columns on a phone.

hub.label: Hub
hub.description: The chip's label: your product or company.

partners.label: Partners
partners.description: The partners, one pill each. Wide canvases get one or two rows under the chip, tall ones two columns; every trace re-routes.

hubIcon.label: Hub icon
hubIcon.description: The mark above the hub label: "m0saic" (the M), "none", or an SVG path d drawn in a 24×24 box (a Simple Icons path pastes straight in).

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Glow colour as #rrggbb: packets, lit traces, lit pills.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the board decoration and the order the partners light up in.

@m0saic-dev/retail/personal-offer/v1.label: Personal Offer
@m0saic-dev/retail/personal-offer/v1.description: A promo clip addressed to one customer: their name, the product picked for them, their discount and their code. The ad is a row of customer data - a weekly send fills the props per customer and every clip renders inside the same signed-off look. Ships generic product art as inline SVG; a real product shot swaps in.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Where the clip is going; sets the canvas it renders at when the resolution is left locked to the template. story is 9:16 (1080x1920) for Stories, Reels and TikTok; feed is 4:5 (1080x1350) for a portrait post; square is 1:1 (1080x1080) for feeds, chat and email tiles; landscape is 16:9 (1920x1080) for an email header, the web or a player. An explicit width and height still win.

customerName.label: Customer name
customerName.description: Who the clip is for: the name in the greeting on the first frame. Required.

greeting.label: Greeting
greeting.description: The word before the name. Empty leaves the name alone.

hook.label: Opening line
hook.description: One line under the greeting, why they are hearing from you this week. Empty removes it.
hook.placeholder: We set something aside for you this week.

brandName.label: Brand
brandName.description: The small wordmark on every frame, and the clip's name. A logo replaces the wordmark on the canvas. Required.

brandLogo.label: Brand logo
brandLogo.description: Zero or one logo in place of the wordmark text: a PNG (or any image) or a short video, which loops muted. Fitted left in the top row - an absolute path from the CLI, or a picked file in Make. Empty draws the brand name.

productKicker.label: Product kicker
productKicker.description: The short line above the product name, in the accent. Empty removes it.

productName.label: Product
productName.description: The product picked for this customer, large, on the second beat. Required.

productNote.label: Product note
productNote.description: One or two sentences about the product, under its name. Empty removes it.
productNote.placeholder: Eau de parfum. Iris, sandalwood and a trace of pink pepper.

productArt.label: Bundled art
productArt.description: Which generic illustration stands in for the product when there is no product shot: perfume, lipstick, cream or serum. Tinted from the accent.

productImage.label: Product shot
productImage.description: Zero or one image of the real product, fitted on the card in place of the bundled art - an absolute path from the CLI, or a picked file in Make.

offerLabel.label: Offer label
offerLabel.description: The short line above the percentage. Empty removes it.

discountPercent.label: Percent off
discountPercent.description: Whole percent off, 1 to 90, drawn as the big line of the last beat.

promoCode.label: Promo code
promoCode.description: The code in the pill, held to the last frame. Mint one per customer. Empty removes the pill.

expiry.label: Ends
expiry.description: When the offer ends, under the code. Empty removes it.
expiry.placeholder: Through Sunday, in store and online

ctaLabel.label: Call to action
ctaLabel.description: What to do next. Empty removes it.

ctaUrl.label: Link
ctaUrl.description: Where to go, under the call to action, in the accent. Empty removes it.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Light (a warm paper page, dark text) or dark (a near-black page, light text). Background and Text override either half when set.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The brand colour: the product card, the kicker, the percentage, the code pill, the link and the progress line, as #rrggbb. The bundled art tints to it.

background.label: Background
background.description: The page colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

ink.label: Text
ink.description: The text colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's. Secondary lines are this colour mixed toward the page.

durationSec.label: Length (s)
durationSec.description: Clip length in whole seconds, 6 to 30. The three beats keep their shares; an explicit duration pin overrides it.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: check the layout contract (every line fits its box, the card stays square, the progress line holds the bottom edge) and draw it over the frame.

@m0saic-dev/sales/pipeline-review/v1.label: Pipeline Review
@m0saic-dev/sales/pipeline-review/v1.description: A quarter's Salesforce opportunities as a leadership dashboard video: closed won, win rate, what slipped past its close month and what is still open, won revenue by month and by region, the deals that need a new close date, and who carried the quarter. Give any headline a note and the video stops on it: the camera zooms in, your note shows below, then it moves on. Every number is derived from the Deals prop, so next quarter is a new paste and a re-render.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.description: The line under the headline. Empty shows the quarter span and the deal count.
subtitle.placeholder: Automatic: quarter span and deal count

quarterStart.label: Quarter starts
quarterStart.description: First month of the quarter as YYYY-MM. Closed deals in its three months count toward the quarter; open deals due by its last month count as slipped.

target.label: Target
target.description: The quarter's bookings target in dollars. Set it and the Closed Won tile shows attainment; 0 shows the deal count instead.

deals.label: Deals
deals.description: The opportunity export, one row per deal: account, region, owner, stage, amount, close month (YYYY-MM). The raw Salesforce CSV pasted as text works too. Stages "Closed Won" and "Closed Lost" are closed; anything else is open.

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: A note per headline for the walkthrough. Each one you fill in becomes a stop: the camera zooms to that headline and holds while the note shows. Stops run in reading order; empty notes are skipped, and the video gets longer to give each note time.

notes.closedWon.label: Closed won
notes.closedWon.description: Your note for the Closed won headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.winRate.label: Win rate
notes.winRate.description: Your note for the Win rate headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.slipped.label: Slipped
notes.slipped.description: Your note for the Slipped headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.openPipeline.label: Open pipeline
notes.openPipeline.description: Your note for the Open pipeline headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.byMonth.label: Won by month
notes.byMonth.description: Your note for the Won by month headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.byRegion.label: Won by region
notes.byRegion.description: Your note for the Won by region headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.slippedList.label: Needs a new close date
notes.slippedList.description: Your note for the Needs a new close date headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.topRegion.label: Top region
notes.topRegion.description: Your note for the Top region headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.topRep.label: Top rep
notes.topRep.description: Your note for the Top rep headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

notes.biggestOpen.label: Biggest open deal
notes.biggestOpen.description: Your note for the Biggest open deal headline, up to 140 characters (two lines). Empty skips it.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Bar colour for the won-by-month and won-by-region charts.

pageColor.label: Page color
pageColor.description: The page background behind the cards.

animate.label: Animate
animate.description: Build the dashboard over the opening seconds, then walk the notes. Off renders a still of the finished board (no camera, no notes).
